explication: Olib is a Flutter ebook-reader client whose book data comes from external sources. Its principal user workflow is searching for a book, viewing its details, downloading it, and reading it offline; the README also documents account and server-line switching. The tree shows additional WeRead, prescriber, shelf, and LAN-import areas, but their runtime wiring was not sampled. Consequently, only documented relationships are solid; uncertain internal connections are omitted.
